title: Normalization
text: 沿行、列或指定维度执行向量归一化，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定舍入模式；{Norm} 指定归一化类型 Squared、{Normalization bias} 指定归一化偏置 1e-10、{Normalize over} 指定要进行归一化的维度 Each、{Dimension} 指定维度、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 输出最小值、{Output Maximum} 输出最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: 归一化输出 scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Normalize over
params.values: 要进行归一化的维度 Each column (default) | Each row | Specified dimension

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as accumulator | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
